Hey — that’s completely fine. We can just start wherever feels easiest; what’s been on your mind lately?
work stuff i guess. nothing dramatic. its actually been ok which is kind of the weird part
That sounds a little oddly unsettled — like “ok” but with a strange edge to it. Does it feel more like uneasy, suspicious, or just hard to settle into?

no not uneasy really. more like. quiet? i finished this big handover at work last week, the thing i was dreading for months. and now its just done. theres nothing in my chest anymore and i dont know what to do with that
That feels like the big pressure has lifted, and now there’s a quiet emptiness where it used to be. Does it feel more blank, relieved, or a bit disorienting?

relieved i think. yeah. i kept bracing for someone to email me with a problem but its been three days and nothing. i actually slept properly for the first time in ages. its just weird to feel ok and not be waiting for the next thing
Relieved, with a kind of unfamiliar quiet after months of bracing for the next email. Does it feel more settled in your body, or still a bit strange?
settled maybe. my shoulders arent up by my ears for once. i didnt realise how much i was carrying it until it was gone. kind of nice actually. didnt expect to be saying that
That sounds settled and a bit gently surprising — the carrying dropped away, and you’re noticing it in your shoulders. Do you want to leave it there for now, or stay with what this relief feels like?
yeah i think ill leave it there. wasnt expecting to actually feel better but i kind of do. thanks
That makes sense — it can be a quiet surprise to feel better after something you were bracing for for so long. I’ll leave it there with you.
